A hardware-accelerated QML item that draws candles: the open, high, low, and close of each data point.

detaileddescription.para: Each data point is an (x, open, high, low, close) quintuple. style draws a candle as a body from its open to its close over a wick from its low to its high, or as an OHLC bar: a line from its low to its high with the open as a tick to the left and the close as a tick to the right. A candle whose close is at or above its open is drawn in upColor, any other in downColor.

A candle is candleWidth times spacing wide, at least minimumWidth pixels. spacing is the smallest positive gap between consecutive x values unless set. To skip non-trading gaps, use the bar index as x and map it to a date with a tick label formatter.

Data points are uploaded to the GPU as a float data texture once per data change; panning, zooming, and changing style, the colors, or the widths only change shader uniforms. The setData() overloads keep doubles and upload them relative to an origin near the viewport, so large coordinates such as epoch timestamps stay precise. The setDataF() overloads store floats and upload them without conversion.

simplesect.title: Invalid data points
simplesect.para: A candle is not drawn or hovered when its x is NaN or ±Inf, or not strictly positive on a log-scale axis, or when its open or close is NaN. A NaN high or low leaves out that half of the wick or line, which then ends at the body. An infinite value, and a value that is not strictly positive on a log-scale axis, extends past the plot edge. Inconsistent values, such as a high below the body, are drawn as given. On a log-scale x axis, a candle whose left edge would be at or below 0 starts at its x. Auto-ranging counts every valid coordinate and widens x by half a candle on each side.

simplesect.title: Hover
simplesect.para: hoveredIndex is the candle whose body, wick, line, or ticks lie within hoverRadius pixels of the cursor, the nearest one when several do, and the one with the highest index on a tie. A valid hoverColor draws it. Only the topmost series under the cursor is hovered: set hoverEnabled to false to leave hover to the series beneath.

simplesect.title: Transitions
simplesect.para: enterTransition animates added candles, updateTransition kept ones, and exitTransition removed ones, matched by index. With a MorphTransition, kept candles move to their new x, open, high, low, and close; a GrowTransition grows the high, low, and close from each candle's open unless its baseline is set. count, candleAt(), the data ranges, spacing, and inspection use the new data from the start of the animation, while hover picks the candles as drawn. While a transition is enabled, the setDataF() overloads store doubles. appendData(), replaceData(), and replacing, clearing, or cancelling a transition skip to the new data; clearData() runs the exit transition.

simplesect.title: Limits
simplesect.para:
At most 16,777,216 (2^24) candles are drawn, fewer on GPUs whose maximum texture size is below
Candles beyond the limit are not drawn or hovered, and a warning is logged once.
